items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And he liked, liked Frank Sinatra, you know.

ctx.x: I had a kid... I had… Well, I did the Litchfield one week only. One week last year. But it conflicts with my other workshops, which I, which I like a lot better. But I had a little kid in Litchfield. He was… God, how big… he was about seven or eight. And he liked, liked Frank Sinatra, you know. So I taught… I had him and I helped him. What I usually do is have them all sing first. I open up with the blues. And I make them sing about what their name is and where they come from and why do they want to sing jazz.…
So is it… Oh, I‟m sorry.
